edits.after: First item: E-into-R kills a squishy Brand.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Nevermove banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: E the carrier, pull the fragment, Q the formation — one root taxed three bars and healed yours.
edits.after: Once E lands you and your ADC delete him instantly — a no-escape mage dies to one root.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 at marksman range — the demon era has a start date; respect it.
edits.after: Spending R to answer poke wastes your drain window — save it for the E-landed all-in.
